::: {.remark .notes}

The two sets of points have the same spread along each coordinate axis,
so the diagonals of their [variance matrices](#def-cov-vec-x) agree. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
The sign of the [covariance](#def-cov) says which diagonal direction, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
$\tp{(1, 1)}$ or $\tp{(1, -1)}$,
has the larger spread.

:::
